status_at_lock: No outcome from model seeds 11001--11040 or split seeds 41001--41040 has been generated or inspected before this manifest was written.
interpretation: A fixed-size 40-pair confirmatory replication of one previously selected dense-network cell. Every declared pair remains in the denominator. This estimates finite-horizon reproducibility for this configuration; it is not an iid trajectory theorem.

p13_n135_k64_polar_manyseed.role: fixed selected cell for fresh many-seed confirmation

analysis_plan.seed_replacement: Forbidden. An interrupted infrastructure attempt may be rerun only with the identical declared model/split pair, and the attempt must be logged.
analysis_plan.primary_endpoint: Strict finite-horizon logged-persistence grokking: an all-step exact training-fit iterate exists; exact training classification is preserved at every subsequent optimizer update; there is a logged checkpoint from which held-out accuracy remains at least 0.90 at every remaining 500-step checkpoint through step 50000; and the delay from exact fit to that persistent checkpoint is at least 5000 updates.
analysis_plan.primary_confirmation_rule: Confirm finite-horizon success probability above 0.80 only if at least 37 of 40 declared runs satisfy the primary endpoint. At 37/40, the two-sided 95% Wilson lower endpoint is 0.80136 and the exact one-sided binomial tail under q=0.80 is approximately 0.02846.
analysis_plan.denominators: Missing, interrupted without successful identical-pair rerun, invalid, nonfinite, rank-deficient where required, missing-observer, and right-censored runs remain failures in all unconditional proportions.
analysis_plan.intervals: Report two-sided 95% Wilson intervals for binary proportions; medians and IQRs for event times and leads; and a fixed-seed bootstrap 95% interval for paired lead medians.
analysis_plan.persistence_resolution: Training-fit preservation is audited at every optimizer update. Held-out accuracy, Fourier, AGOP, refit, and direction persistence are resolved only on the locked 500-step checkpoint grid.

event_definitions.exact_fit: First all-step iterate with exact training classification.
event_definitions.first_logged_postfit: First locked 500-step checkpoint at or after the exact all-step fit time; this is the baseline for logged alignment changes.
event_definitions.persistent_test_90: First logged checkpoint after which every remaining logged test accuracy is at least 0.90.
event_definitions.persistent_Aplus_80: First logged checkpoint after which every remaining logged fourier_sum_full_hidden_span_coverage is at least 0.80.
event_definitions.persistent_full_hidden_refit_90: First logged checkpoint after which every remaining logged full_hidden_train_only_refit_heldout_modular_accuracy is at least 0.90.

mechanism_endpoints: Persistent A+ >=0.80 precedes persistent network test accuracy >=0.90.
Persistent full-hidden train-only refit accuracy >=0.90 precedes persistent network test accuracy >=0.90.
Held-out rank-12 AGOP addition-minus-difference purity has positive net change from the first logged checkpoint at or after exact fit to persistent test-90.
theory_train_optimizer_posttangent_feature_update_rule_cosine is strictly positive at at least 90% of logged checkpoints from exact fit through persistent test-90.
analysis_plan.mechanism_reporting: Report each mechanism endpoint unconditionally over all 40 declared runs, as well as conditionally among primary successes. Do not require an ordering between A+ and the full-hidden refit.
analysis_plan.fixed_sequence_mechanism_confirmation: Test the composite mechanism rate only if the primary endpoint first passes its 37/40 confirmation rule. The composite requires strict grokking, persistent A+ and persistent full-hidden refit both preceding persistent test-90, positive fit-to-grok gain in held-out rank-12 AGOP addition-minus-difference purity, and a strictly positive train post-tangent update/rule cosine at at least 90% of logged fit-to-grok checkpoints. Confirm a composite rate above 0.80 only at 37/40 or more; otherwise report descriptively without claiming confirmation.

ce_plateau.primary_interpretation: The robust plateau is preserved exact training classification, not constant raw cross-entropy.
ce_plateau.fixed_pretransition_window: For a run with persistent test-90 at t_g, use the inclusive logged interval [t_g-5000,t_g]. Report R_CE=(max train CE-min train CE)/mean train CE and the fraction with R_CE<=0.10.
ce_plateau.adaptive_overlap_secondary: Also report the older inclusive interval rule: contains the persistent test-90 checkpoint, duration at least 5000, exact logged train accuracy one throughout, and train-CE range/mean <=0.10. This is secondary and is not part of primary confirmation.

analysis_plan.direction_observer_semantics: The update-direction and full-table rule quantities are observer-only retrospective diagnostics and never enter training. Post-tangent fields describe the first-order row-sphere retraction velocity, excluding decay and the finite retraction.
analysis_plan.claim_boundary: The study can confirm reproducibility and empirical theorem-interface chronology for this fixed p,n,k,optimizer,horizon distribution. It cannot prove adaptive cone invariance, signed residual contraction, arbitrary-p scaling, or a fresh-run 1-delta theorem.
